main_text.p: sticorum vescuntur, necesse est ut mutetur temperamentum eorum in temperamentum, isti, quod huiusmodi affinis proprium est simile, quo fit ut hebetes evadant, aliisque qualitatibus afinos istos referant. Atque hinc est quòd carne ovina magis quàm aliorum animalium carnibus vesci permissum sit, quia huic animali non attribuitur qualitas aliqua vituperio digna, quam ejus esu acquirat homo. Et ob eandem causam prohibita sunt multorum animalium carnes,, quod rebus sc. noxiis pasci soleant. Ideóque interdicta est caro Leonum, aliorumque ejusmodi ferarum, quarum natura aequalis temperamenti terminos excedit, ne esu carnium earum, ejusmodi naturam & ipse homo induat.

Si quibus nominibus, aut quâ specie, coluerint Arabes corpora ista coelestia, expressisset Author noster, melius intelligeremus, quae ab aliis de idololatrico eorum cultu traduntur, ab his sono saltem diversa. Ea, ut cum his conferri possint, paucis referemus: ac primò quae in Alcorano recensentur Idolorum nomina. qualia in Suratè l Nojm. occurrunt, الّلات Allatt, العزى Alozza, & مناة Manab; quae sub nomine foeminino culta monent hæc verba الكم الذكور i. e. Num vobis masculi erunt, & ولَه الانثى [Deo sc.] fœmina? Vobis filii, Deo filiæ? Vos qui filias calamitatis loco ducitis, eásque vobis nasci ægrè fertis, nec vivere finitis, Deo tamen adscribitis, & fœminas honoris illi soli debiti participes facitis, & الهة Elahat, i. e. Deas appellatis? Angelos enim & Idola quae vel à Deo vitâ inspirari credebant, vel هياكل الملائكة i. e. Angelorum sacella esse, ac ab iis animari, Dei filias vocabant, & quod apud Deum pro se inter-

page.notes: Printed Arabic and transliterations copied as seen; the Arabic word after "&" (Elahat) and the Arabic of "Manab" are not fully clear: [?] not added because the forms are legible in the scan but should be checked. Italic/roman boundaries in the first paragraph and in the sentences "Et ob eandem causam..." and "Ideóque..." are uncertain and were set on best reading. The first paragraph begins with "sticorum" (long s); the scan's first letter looks like a ligature, so checking against the original is advised. Printed "Suratè l Nojm" and "Alcorano" retained as printed. Printed "Deo sc." bracket is a printer's insertion, kept. Printed letters "probibita" in the first paragraph appear as "prohibita" in the scan; kept as printed by reading "probibita" is an error; check against original. Note text: "P.5.17." is in the right margin beside the italic summary line.
